name: AI Usage
author: AkitaOnRails
description: Multi-provider AI plan usage and balances in a native Omarchy Quattro panel. Needs the ai-usagebar binary as well as this plugin: omarchy pkg aur add ai-usagebar-bin

barWidget.description: Usage windows, reset countdowns, balances, and provider switching for every provider configured in ai-usagebar. This is the display frontend only — install the binary with omarchy pkg aur add ai-usagebar-bin.

schema.label: Provider or account id
schema.description: Optional id from ai-usagebar usage --json (for example openai or anthropic@work). Leave blank to switch between all configured entries.

schema.label: Show usage value
schema.description: Show the selected provider's percentage or balance next to the icon in the top bar.

schema.label: Show provider logos
schema.description: Draw each provider's own mark in the top bar and panel. Off restores the generic icon the bar used before the marks: one robot for a single provider, and the provider's short code on each chip when Show all providers is on. On by default.

schema.label: Show provider names on tabs
schema.description: Show each provider's name beside its logo in the panel tabs. Off shows logos only, with the name on hover. Always on when provider logos are off. On by default.

schema.label: Show provider name
schema.description: Show the selected provider's short code (cld, gpt, zai, agy) before the usage value, the way Waybar's {vendor_short} does. Off by default.

schema.label: Color-code usage by level
schema.description: Paint bar values, panel meters, and the tooltip green → yellow → orange → red as usage climbs, using your Omarchy theme. Turn off for a single foreground color. Off by default.

schema.label: Show all providers
schema.description: Show every configured provider's icon and usage in the top bar at once, instead of cycling one at a time. Off by default.

schema.label: Interface language
schema.description: Language for the Omarchy panel and settings. Auto follows the system locale.

schema.label: Top bar usage window
schema.description: Which quota window the top bar shows. Auto keeps the highest percent; 5-hour pins the session/rolling window; weekly pins the 7-day window; monthly pins the monthly pool where one exists. Falls back to highest when a vendor lacks the pinned window.

schema.label: Show usage as
schema.description: Whether percentages in the top bar, tooltip and panel read what you have used or what is left of the same window. Which window the bar picks does not change; only the number drawn for it does.

schema.label: Show Cursor Models
schema.description: Show the Cursor Models pool in the top bar and tooltip. The panel header and list drop it too. At least one Cursor pool stays visible.

schema.label: Show Other Models
schema.description: Show the Other Models pool in the top bar and tooltip. The panel header and list drop it too. At least one Cursor pool stays visible.

schema.label: Show On-Demand
schema.description: Show prepaid on-demand usage in the top bar and tooltip. The panel header and list drop it too. At least one Cursor pool stays visible.

schema.label: Show Credits
schema.description: Show a spending-page credit grant in the top bar and tooltip. The panel header and list drop it too. Hidden when the account has no grant. At least one Cursor figure stays visible.

schema.label: Show Gemini
schema.description: Show the Gemini pool in the top bar and tooltip. The panel list drops its Session and Weekly rows too. At least one Antigravity pool stays visible.

schema.label: Show Claude & GPT OSS
schema.description: Show the Claude & GPT OSS pool in the top bar and tooltip. The panel list drops its Session and Weekly rows too. At least one Antigravity pool stays visible.

schema.label: Enable usage priorities
schema.description: Show the recommended order of use inside the same popup. A quota at risk of going unused before its reset turns red in the bar. Off by default; while off, nothing is recorded.

schema.label: Show priority in the bar
schema.description: Always show the recommended provider in the bar as a shortcut to the priorities. An urgent quota appears in red even when this is off.

schema.label: Recent usage window (hours)
schema.description: Look back 1–24 hours for the priority calculation. Applies immediately.

schema.label: Alert in the bar
schema.description: Show a provider in red in the bar when its quota is at risk of going unused (see the two thresholds below).

schema.label: Alert when projected unused quota is at least (%)
schema.description: Projected unused percentage at reset, at the current pace, that makes a quota urgent.

schema.label: …and the quota resets within (hours)
schema.description: Only quota windows longer than this qualify, so a 5-hour session never alerts.

schema.label: Report command
schema.description: Executable used for usage --json, settings and Nous login. Leave as ai-usagebar unless you run a local build.

schema.label: Dashboard command
schema.description: Executable opened by right-click and the dashboard action. Leave as ai-usagebar-tui unless you run a local build.
